mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) reduces discount rates on equity cash flows, leading to positive 20-day S&P 500 returns. The signal is always active and the direction is positive.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS < 4.0% and SPX 20-day returns are negative in >55% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the federal funds rate above 4.0% signals monetary tightening, compressing equity valuations and leading to negative 20-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >55% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 4.0%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 4.0%) and rising inflation (CPIAUCSL > 212.0) signals an impending monetary policy response, leading to negative 20-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: HOUST > 1000 AND INDPRO < 114.0 and SPX 20-day returns are positive in >55% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime (UNRATE < 4.0% and GDP growth > 2.5% annually), a rising housing market (HOUST > 1000) signals strong consumer demand, leading to positive 20-day S&P 500 returns.
regime_hint: late-cycle expansion (UNRATE < 4.0% and GDP growth > 2.5% annually)
failure_condition: In the late-cycle expansion regime, HOUST > 1000 and SPX 20-day returns are negative in >55% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate above 5.0% signals economic weakness, leading to negative 20-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >55% of instances where UNRATE > 5.0%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A high level of employment (PAYEMS) is associated with positive 20-day S&P 500 returns due to sustained consumer spending and corporate earnings growth.
failure_condition: PAYEMS > 138000 and SPX 20-day returns are negative in >55% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of rising housing starts (HOUST > 1000) and falling industrial production (INDPRO < 114.0) signals a slowing economy, leading to negative 20-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: HOUST > 1000 AND INDPRO < 114.0 and SPX 20-day returns are positive in >55% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a housing market recovery regime (HOUST > 1000 and RSAFS > 380000), a rising industrial production (INDPRO > 114.0) signals improving economic conditions, leading to positive 20-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: In the housing market recovery regime, INDPRO > 114.0 and SPX 20-day returns are negative in >55% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
